result.description:
Claude just helped uncover a previously unknown biological system—and how it found it might be the bigger story. Anthropic’s agents searched for roughly 21 hours before researchers followed up on a strange pattern in DNA. We look at ART, the surprising signals inside Mythos 5, and what this could mean for the pace of scientific discovery. ART’s function is still unknown, but the clues are fascinating.

result.title: AI labs may be hiding their biggest breakthroughs
result.description:
Scott Aaronson thinks the singularity has already started—and says he’s heard that AI companies are sitting on major mathematical breakthroughs they haven’t released. As the debate over OpenAI’s Navier–Stokes result continues, a bigger question is emerging: what happens when machines can make discoveries that humans struggle to understand? We explore the warning signs, the backlash, and what scientific progress could mean for human purpose.

result.title: Google is SO back...
result.description:
Google researchers are letting AI “dream” through past experiments to improve how it chooses what to try next. Dream-RSI turns recorded discoveries into replayable worlds, where an agent can test better research strategies before running new experiments. Could learning to choose the right experiment become a key building block for recursive self-improvement?
